creator: admin
title: Welcome
text:
This wiki is a live demo of [[TiddlyWiki on Cloudflare|https://github.com/DesignThinkerer/tiddlywiki-cloudflare]]: a TiddlyWiki hosted on Cloudflare's free plan, deployed from the project's repository with nothing edited.

You are reading the ''public site''. It is read-only, served from Cloudflare's cache, and costs the owner nothing per visit. The owner edits the same wiki on a separate ''admin site'', behind a login.
